reference.engine: DotLiquid master at SyntaxCompatibility.DotLiquid20 with the Adxstudio filter and tag layer Power Pages registers after it

dotliquid.2.0.64: NuGet DotLiquid 2.0.64 (2016-12-22, AppVeyor build of commit fadc6b31a33a)

reference.harness: net7.0 console: Template.Parse, then Render with the case data as Hash.FromDictionary (arrays as List<object>, en-US culture, RethrowErrors false). An error is a parse exception or a recorded render error; undefined-variable notices (VariableNotFoundException) are not errors.

reasons.symbols: `blank` and `empty` resolve to `DotLiquid.Util.Symbol` (Context.Resolve): output renders the type name, and string, math or relational use raises the .NET conversion error.
reasons.root-bracket: A root bracket is read with `Resolve(…).ToString()` (Context.TryGetVariable). The bracket ends at the first `]` (VariableParser `\[[^\]]+\]`), resolves to nil and raises NullReferenceException.
reasons.identifier-grammar: DotLiquid's regex grammar decides the names: paths are scanned with VariableParser `\[[^\]]+\]|[\w-]+\??` (other characters are skipped), `assign` and `capture` accept `[\w-]` names including a leading hyphen or only digits, and `for` takes a `\w+` loop variable.
reasons.no-operators: DotLiquid has no arithmetic operators: a Variable keeps the first expression of its markup and ignores the rest, so `1 + 2` is `1`.
reasons.multiline-token: At DotLiquid20 a `{{ … }}` or `{% … %}` token cannot contain a line break (the tokenizer regexes do not match newlines), so markup with a newline, even inside a string literal, is a syntax error.
reasons.range-literal: Range literals match `^\((\S+)\.\.(\S+)\)$` (Context.Resolve) and convert their bounds with Convert.ToInt32: a non-numeric string raises FormatException, a float bound is rounded, and spaces around `..` leave no range (nil).
reasons.first-last: StandardFilters.First/Last take an IEnumerable (the Strainer raises InvalidCastException for a number); a Hash enumerates `[key, value]` pairs and renders as the concatenation of its entries, so an empty hash renders nothing.
reasons.at-least-most: StandardFilters.AtLeast/AtMost compare only when the input and the argument are numbers and otherwise return the input unchanged.
reasons.capitalize: At DotLiquid20 StandardFilters.Capitalize title-cases every word (ExtendedFilters.Titleize); upper-casing only the first character starts at DotLiquid21.
reasons.date-format: StandardFilters.Date formats with .NET format strings (Liquid.UseRubyDateFormat is false), so strftime directives are .NET format text or a FormatException, and a number is not read as a Unix timestamp (unparseable input is returned).
reasons.math: DotLiquid20 math (StandardFilters.DoMathsOperation): integer and decimal operands keep their .NET types and decimal results render without trailing zeros (`10 | divided_by: 2.0` is `5`); string operands are not parsed as numbers (`plus` concatenates a string input, the other operators raise `The binary operator … is not defined`), and a nil operand renders nothing.
reasons.enumerable-input: join and reverse take an IEnumerable: a string enumerates its characters (`'a,b' | join: '#'` is `a#,#b`) and the Strainer raises InvalidCastException for a number.
reasons.map: StandardFilters.Map reads the property of each Hash or drop and yields nil for other items, without flattening nested arrays; a Hash input maps its key/value pairs.
reasons.nil-search: With a nil search argument StandardFilters.Remove raises (String.Replace with an empty value) and Replace/ReplaceFirst return the input unchanged.
reasons.string-parameter: String filters declare System.String parameters: the Strainer cannot convert a Hash input and raises ArgumentException.
reasons.slice: StandardFilters.Slice: the Strainer converts the offset and length to Int32 (2.2 becomes 2, nil becomes 0), an enumerable input (including a range) is sliced by items, and other input is returned unchanged.
reasons.split: StandardFilters.Split returns `[input]` for a blank input, so an empty string splits into one empty item.
reasons.truncate-nil-length: A nil length reaches StandardFilters.Truncate as 0 (reflection passes default(int)), so only the ellipsis remains.
reasons.url-encode: url_encode uses System.Net.WebUtility.UrlEncode, which leaves `!` unencoded.
reasons.input-only-filters: StandardFilters.Compact and Uniq take only the input: a property argument raises TargetParameterCountException (Strainer.Invoke); Uniq keeps distinct items with Equals, so hashes render their type name.
reasons.sort: Sort and SortNatural at DotLiquid20 use StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.Compare(object, object) in List.Sort: strings compare without case or natural ordering, characters and numbers compare by value, nil sorts first, and values that are not IComparable (hashes without a key) raise `Failed to compare two elements in the array`.
reasons.case-lax: Case accepts `when` values separated by `or` or `,` (WhenSyntax) and ignores the rest of the markup, so an unexpected token is not an error.
reasons.comment-raw: `comment` is a RawBlock in DotLiquid master: its body is not parsed, so the first `endcomment` ends it (nested `comment` and `raw` tags are not counted) and incomplete markup inside is not an error.
reasons.whitespace-control: DotLiquid20 whitespace control: `{%-`/`{{-` trim spaces and tabs only and `-%}`/`-}}` remove one following newline or one run of spaces and tabs (Tokenizer; confirmed live, see liquid-parity.md); whitespace-only blocks are not suppressed.
reasons.for-loop: For has no `forloop.parentloop` (it renders nothing) and iterates the characters of a string.
reasons.blank-blocks: DotLiquid renders blocks that contain only whitespace (and comments); Shopify Liquid suppresses them.
reasons.conditions: Conditions follow DotLiquid's Condition: `==` converts the right operand with Convert.ChangeType (`1 == '1'`, `'1' == 1`, `1 == true` and `0 == false` are true) and `>` compares a string with a number; array `contains` finds false and nil items; ranges compare by reference; `contains` with a number on a string raises InvalidCastException; `startswith`, `endswith`, `haskey` and `hasvalue` are operators.
reasons.include: Include has no `with … as` alias (the value is bound to the template name), and a `break` inside an included template ends only that template (Document.Render catches the interrupt).
reasons.tablerow: TableRow writes each row with TextWriter.WriteLine (CRLF on Windows), converts `cols`, `limit` and `offset` with Convert.ToInt32 (strings and floats are accepted), puts every item in one row when `cols` is missing, and `break`/`continue` leave the row unclosed.
reasons.adx-default: Power Pages registers Adxstudio Filters.Default(object input, object default) => input ?? default over DotLiquid's: only nil falls back (false, empty strings and empty collections are kept; a decimal keeps its value and renders without trailing zeros), and it takes exactly one argument, so `allow_false` raises TargetParameterCountException and a missing argument a SyntaxException.
reasons.adx-ceil-floor: Power Pages registers Adxstudio MathFilters.Ceil/Floor(object value): nil gives 0, otherwise Convert.ToDecimal(value), which raises for a non-numeric string or a hash.
reasons.adx-round: Power Pages registers Adxstudio MathFilters.Round(object value, int decimals = 0): the Strainer converts the argument to Int32 (FormatException for 'foo') and Math.Round(decimal, decimals) accepts 0 to 28 digits.
reasons.adx-concat: Power Pages registers Adxstudio EnumerableFilters.Concat(IEnumerable first, object second): a string operand enumerates its characters, a nil or non-enumerable second operand is appended as one item, and nothing is flattened.
reasons.adx-where: Power Pages registers Adxstudio EnumerableFilters.Where(IEnumerable input, string key, object value): the value is required and items are kept when their key value Equals it (nil matches nil or a missing key; a nil key matches every item).
reasons.nested-collection-type: A nested collection renders its .NET type name. The harness data are `List<object>` (``System.Collections.Generic.List`1[System.Object]``); Mirage arrays do not record the .NET collection type that produced them and render as `System.Object[]`.

rules.reason: No `liquid` tag: DotLiquid's tag registry (Liquid.cs) has none and Power Pages registers none (Adxstudio LiquidExtensions), so the tag is an unknown-tag syntax error.
No inline comment tag: DotLiquid's tag token takes a `\w+` name (Liquid.cs FullToken), so `{% # … %}` is a syntax error.
No `echo` tag: DotLiquid's tag registry (Liquid.cs) has none and Power Pages registers none (Adxstudio LiquidExtensions), so the tag is an unknown-tag syntax error.
No `render` tag: DotLiquid's tag registry (Liquid.cs) has none and Power Pages registers none (Adxstudio LiquidExtensions), so the tag is an unknown-tag syntax error.
No `doc` tag: DotLiquid's tag registry (Liquid.cs) has none and Power Pages registers none (Adxstudio LiquidExtensions), so the tag is an unknown-tag syntax error.
No `has` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `reject` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `find` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `find_index` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `sum` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `squish` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `replace_last` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `remove_last` filter in DotLiquid master StandardFilters or the Adxstudio filter classes; DotLiquid returns the input of an unknown filter unchanged (Context.Invoke).
No `truncatewords` filter: DotLiquid registers StandardFilters.TruncateWords as `truncate_words` (Ruby naming convention); an unknown filter returns its input unchanged.
